title: santifer/career-ops
claim: santifer/career-ops — Open-source AI job search: scan job portals, evaluate listings with a structured A-F rubric into a 1.0-5.0 score, tailor
why_good: The structured scoring system can provide a unique and objective way for job seekers to assess opportunities beyond traditional metrics.
value: Companies could pay for premium access to tailored job listings and analytics to improve their hiring processes and candidate matching.
risk: The project may struggle to scale if larger job platforms integrate similar features, overshadowing its unique offering.
